BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current C!-2 Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 3-1 in the area bounded by:

A line 316.00 feet north of and parallel to West Chicago Avenue; North
California Avenue; a line 291.00 feet north of and parallel to West Chicago
Avenue; and the public alley next west of and parallel to North Califomia Avenue

to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Address: 830 North Califormia Avenue
